ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Anything but Consensus: Twentieth Century U.S. Political History Description: This course introduces students to historical interpretation through an examination of Americans who have dared to reshape the United States in the twentieth century. A range of leaders and case studies will be examined to explore the ways in which historians have documented how change has occurred in cities, workplaces, and a range of other sites in the United States. Over the course of the semester, students will improve their research skills and writing practices as they conduct their own research and produce a final research project.
